_comment: Terraces on the rock relief (docs/terraces.md). Every number is here; loaded once at startup. Metres = blocks.
_mode_note: terrace = R' = lerp(R, stair(R), strength); off = R' = R exactly (prompt 06)
_step_note: step height H(x,z) in metres: min..max driven by a seeded noise (value * gain, clamped to -1..1)
_level_note: level offset O(x,z) in metres, +-amplitude: the shelf levels drift from place to place; phase p = (R + O) / H
_stair_note: inside one step (fractional phase f): the tread takes f in [0, 1 - riser_input) and rises tread_rise of the step, linearly; the riser takes the rest of the input and the rest of the rise as a cubic Hermite with the tread slope at both ends, so the lip and the foot are rounded and the curve is monotone and C1. riser_input = (1 - tread_rise) * ground slope / riser_slope, clamped to min..max: wide treads where the ground is gentle, the riser leaning at about riser_slope (blocks per block) on average. detail_keep: the stair squeezes the fine surface detail by about the tread rise; this share of it is added back so treads are never dead level
_strength_note: terrace strength 0..1 from a seeded noise; times the small-body factor; times a fade over the first fade_r1 metres of rock height (the coast and the dune banking keep the smooth shape)
_small_note: local rock half-width (largest distance from the sand within window metres): strength x smoothstep((w - lo) / (hi - lo)); a rock under 80 m across is not terraced at all, a few hundred metres across lightly
_limit_note: the strength is lowered wherever the terraced surface would climb more than max_slope blocks per block, so no riser is steeper than a run of 1-block steps
